ja: • 本格SFロボットアニメ『ノブナガ・ザ・フール』より、主人公機が立体化。
• 本体サイズは全高150mm。本体各所に雷、火、風の各神器の装着が可能。
• 神器同士を組み合わせることで新たなウェポンが誕生。

en: • From the authentic sci-fi robot anime ``Nobunaga the Fool'', the main character's machine is now three-dimensional.
• The main body size is 150mm in total height. It is possible to attach sacred treasures of lightning, fire, and wind to various parts of the main body.
• A new weapon is created by combining sacred treasures.
Molded product x 11, foil seal x 1, marking seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
